messages:
olivia: Seeing connection pool slowly grow on our mobile prod tests after toggling Wi‑Fi + backgrounding the app. Using Retrofit 2.9 + OkHttp 4.10. Anyone seen this before?

sam: Yup. Had a flaky run where idle connections never got evicted. KeepAlive/cleanup timer seems to stop when the device goes to sleep.

devon: Are you using the suspend Call adapter or a custom Dispatcher? Coroutine cancellation sometimes doesn't call call.cancel() depending on the adapter.

olivia: We use the common suspend extension (suspendCancellableCoroutine) and we do call.cancel on cancellation. Still repros. Minimal logs pasted below:

```
D/OkHttp: ConnectionPool: totalConnections=12, idle=12
E/HttpStream: unexpected end of stream on Connection{10.0.0.3:443, proxy=DIRECT hostAddress=/10.0.0.3:443 cipherSuite=TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256} -- sending CANCEL
W/Network: Socket closed during keepalive check
```

sam: That stack looks like the socket was closed by the OS while OkHttp's cleanup thread was paused. On many devices the ScheduledExecutor for evictions doesn't tick while the CPU is suspended. OkHttp relies on that thread to evict dead sockets.

devon: One painful workaround is calling connectionPool.evictAll() on lifecycle events like onStop or onConnectivityChange. It prevents growth but causes cold-start latency and extra reconnects when user resumes.

olivia: Tried evictAll on onPause. It helps but spikes RPS on resume and we saw extra 503s from backend due to thundering reconnects. Not great.

sam: I opened a PR with a conservative fix: detect wifi connectivity transitions and run pool.evictAll() + make the cleanup schedule resilient by re-scheduling on system wake. Patch here: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2468>. Also added a note about device doze in the README.

devon: Another angle: ensure our coroutine adapter actually propagates cancellation to OkHttp earlier. I saw cases where enqueue callbacks still run after cancellation and we end up re-issuing requests. That amplifies load after resume.

android-ci-bot: Build passed for PR 2468 on android-integration-tests (artifact: 8.3.1-beta) :white_check_mark:

olivia: Nice. Can we add a tiny sample app to devex/samples that reproduces the Wi‑Fi suspend case? Having a reproducible sample will make mobile SDK parity tests more robust.

sam: Good plan — I'll add a minimal sample and a flaky integration test that toggles connectivity on an emulator and asserts pool size stays bounded.

devon: I'll refine the PR to avoid evictAll on every transition (only when socket errors spike) and add a unit test that simulates the ScheduledExecutor being paused (mocked clock). Might need to expose a test hook on the ConnectionPool.

olivia: Thanks. Assigning follow-ups: @devon refine PR + tests, @sam add sample + integration test. I'll coordinate hotfix rollout for Dedicated mobile build today. :thumbsup:
